labels.collapse: Collapse to x = y (Vampire proof; no probe obeys them)
labels.joins: Equivalent to an older law (Vampire proofs both ways)
labels.new: New class: a probe separates it from every older law
labels.new_by_vampire: New class: fingerprint twins of old classes, all refuted by Vampire
labels.residue: Residue: not settled within the time limits

new_classes_lower_bound_note: new laws with different fingerprints cannot be equivalent, so the number of distinct fingerprints among new-class laws is a lower bound
vampire_limits: first pass 0.5-2 s per question; second look: finite-model search 0.3 s each way, then proof attempts 0.6 s each way
